title: Unit 13 Review: Health & Bioethics
goal: Consolidate obligation registers, clinical sequencing, formal concession, universal relatives and counterfactual accountability in bioethics.

items: I can distinguish moral duty, retrospective ethical critique and legal requirement in health contexts.
I can sequence clinical steps with *antes de que*, *después de que* and *después de haber* + participle.
I can weigh clinical benefits against ethical risks with *a pesar de que*, *pese a* and universal relatives.
I can evaluate past clinical and public-health decisions with counterfactual conditionals.
